summary: Small rectangular green PCB carrier for a Hall-effect current sensor. A black 5-pin SOT-23 sensor sits at the center. Two large current-terminal pads (IP+ and IP-) are on the left edge, each with a round hole and an elongated slot. Three 0.1-inch-pitch round through-holes (VOUT, VDD, GND) are in a column along the right edge.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat underside of the PCB, usable as the seating face when the board is soldered to header pins or wires.
Top face of the PCB carrying the SOT-23 sensor and the two current-terminal pads. The pads are about 0.25 mm above the board face in this estimate.

notes: Only the length (10.2 mm) and width (7.6 mm) come from the supplied data, and that data is flagged unverified. They match the stated 0.4 in x 0.3 in size. The 0.1 in (2.54 mm) pin pitch is stated. Height is not given, so the z value is an estimate: roughly a 1.6 mm PCB plus a SOT-23 body of about 1.1 mm. The hole diameters, the hole positions and the x offset of the pin column are estimated from image proportions. The slot in each current pad is not modeled. The board is centered on the origin, with the IP+/IP- pads on the -x side and the VOUT/VDD/GND pins on the +x side. The mounting-surface offsets assume the PCB is about 1.6 mm thick and centered on z = 0, which is also an estimate.
